hook: Why the internet's core protocol was never patented.

beats.say: Vint Cerf co-designed TCP/IP with Bob Kahn in the 1970s. Their paper came out in May 1974.
Why no patent? They didn't know who their allies would be twenty-five years later, so the only way to guarantee access was to open it up.
Now 83, Cerf left Google after more than twenty years and is helping start Tolero, building software for an internet between planets.
